labour.headline: Simulated Labour Office reports October employment
labour.text:
November 6, 2026

Simulated Labour Office reports October employment

The Simulated Labour Office said payroll employment rose by 142,000 in October 2026, after a revised gain of 98,000 in September. The unemployment rate was 4.3 percent, unchanged from September.

Average hourly earnings increased 0.3 percent over the month and 3.8 percent over the year.

Chief Statistician Nora Pell said the October survey response rate was lower than usual. Deputy Director Sam Ortiz said manufacturing employment was little changed.

The office did not report employment by region.

SYNTHETIC TEST SOURCE written for the QA holdout research-quality cases.

trade.headline: Simulated Trade Ministry publishes monthly trade figures
trade.text:
December 3, 2026

Simulated Trade Ministry publishes monthly trade figures

The Simulated Trade Ministry said the goods trade deficit narrowed to 61.2 billion dollars in October 2026 from 67.5 billion dollars in September.

Exports increased 2.1 percent, while imports declined 1.4 percent.

Minister Eda Kran said the ministry would not change its tariff schedule before March 2027. Undersecretary Paul Ives said shipping costs had fallen.

The ministry did not give figures for services trade.
